description_en: Queries the hot spot annotation configuration, which is used during post-processing
description_zh: 查询热点标注配置,后处理时使用
kebab_example: aliyun tdsr get-hotspot-config --preview-token 344794c32937474a9c59eb1309360000 --type 0 --enabled false --domain www.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHotspotConfig

parameters.help_en:
The publish status. Valid values:
- 0: unpublished
- 1: published
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable access to self-owned resources. This must be enabled before publishing the scene
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自用资源访问（需要在发布场景之前开启）
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The custom OSS domain name. This can be a CDN domain name
parameters.name: domain
